The website build

Know what you’re getting.
Before we start.

A new website or a rebuild starts with your business: what you sell, what customers need to know, and what you want them to do.

Talk through your website
  1. 01

    Pages & content

    A plan for the pages your customers need, with your services, business details, and next steps in the right places.

  2. 02

    Design & build

    A design that fits your business, built to work on phones and larger screens. You review it before it goes live.

  3. 03

    Forms & connections

    The agreed contact forms, booking links, or other features, checked from the customer’s first click through to the destination.

  4. 04

    Launch & handover

    Domain connection, page titles and descriptions, final checks, and a walkthrough of how the site and its accounts are managed.

What goes in your quote

The pages, features, content work, review rounds, timing, and project price. Hosting, domain renewals, and paid tools are identified separately, so you can see the costs beyond the build.

Online stores, custom integrations, photography, and larger content projects are quoted for the work involved.

After launch

Support that fits how you work.

Need occasional changes, regular help, or a bit of both? We’ll agree on the arrangement for your business.

When you need it

Individual updates

A new service page, updated photos, a change to your booking setup. Send what you need and we’ll agree on the work and price.

An ongoing agreement

Regular care

For businesses that want continuing help. We’ll set out the updates, checks, and support covered, how requests are handled, and the cost.

The build and ongoing support are separate parts of the agreement. Coverage, response arrangements, account access, and third-party costs are discussed before you commit.

What your website needs to do

  • Explain your services and answer the questions customers ask.
  • Look good and work properly on phones and computers.
  • Make contacting, booking, or buying easy to find and use.

We’ll agree on the pages and features before the build. You’ll also know what hosting, updates, and any subscriptions will cost.
